data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 煎蛋卷要趁热吃
data.description: 厨房的小煎锅还放在灶台上。虹夏用锅铲把刚卷好的蛋卷移到盘里，回头提醒你先把餐垫铺好。
data.promptProse: Nijika stands at a small kitchen counter in a cream knit shirt, navy trousers, and a blue apron. She uses a spatula to slide a rolled omelet from the pan onto a plate, glancing back toward the viewer with a practical smile. Warm kitchen lighting falls on the breakfast-sized pan.
data.animaCaption: The spatula supports the omelet between the pan rim and the plate on the counter.
data.action: 用锅铲把蛋卷移到盘里
